title: Irish Baked Flatbread with Dried Tomatoes
description: A simple and flavorful flatbread recipe featuring dried tomatoes and a touch of Irish charm.
instructions: Cut the dried tomatoes into small pieces and set aside.
Roll out the flatbread to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the flatbread to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the flatbread, leaving a 1/2 inch (1 cm) border around the edges.
Sprinkle the sea salt, garlic powder, and dried tomatoes over the flatbread.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and top with chopped fresh basil, Parmesan cheese (if using), and a drizzle of balsamic vinegar.
